snippet.title: Version 1.4 EP - "The Prisoner In The Cave" | Reverse: 1999
snippet.description:
Upon the silent sea, the eternal and ever-circulating current has been cut off. In the transcendental sky, several dazzling stars align. Who led us to the exile in this cave?
Close your eyes, for all secret knowledge is hidden behind the wall of silent boulders. 

Version 1.4 of #Reverse1999, "The Prisoner In The Cave," is now available on Mobile and PC.
